ae10453c-dd38-4ffb-ad18-9130a94d8f96/Eve.en: "Use Ao Slaying Blade Art with your sword!"<NL>Foster Father shouted loudly, but this time the voice was no longer projected into your ears directly.<NL>Hearing this, Immortal Xu stumbled on his left foot in surprise, revealing the opening in his legs!
ae10453c-dd38-4ffb-ad18-9130a94d8f96/Eve.ru: "Используй Искусство клинка Ао для убийства своим Мечом!"<NL>Приемный отец громко закричал, но на этот раз голос больше не проецировался непосредственно в ваши уши.<NL>Услышав это, Бессмертный Сюй от удивления споткнулся на левой ноге, открыв отверстие в своих ногах!

35f2f3f7-54d9-42e4-86e6-b12a27788c92/Eve.en: "You're no match for me, little girl. Kowtow to me thrice and call me Immortal Xu trice.<NL>Then, I'll allow you to tuck tail and run!"
35f2f3f7-54d9-42e4-86e6-b12a27788c92/Eve.ru: - Ты мне не ровня, малышка. Трижды поклонись мне и трижды назови меня Бессмертным Сюй.<NL>Тогда я позволю тебе поджать хвост и убежать!"

35f2f3f7-54d9-42e4-86e6-b12a27788c92/Opt.en: You shameless Outlaw! How dare you call yourself Immortal Xu? I don't need my Father to deal with you. I will grind you into dust myself!
35f2f3f7-54d9-42e4-86e6-b12a27788c92/Opt.ru: Ты бесстыдный преступник! Как ты смеешь называть себя Бессмертным Сюй? Мне не нужен мой отец, чтобы иметь с тобой дело. Я сам сотру тебя в порошок!

f3abb91f-ec41-4876-ba08-e4ab5e03d624/Eve.en: "Come to me, my daughter. Leave him be for now.<NL>We do not have the means to defeat Immortal Xu at this very moment.<NL>After I regain my powers in two days' time, however, he will not find us easy prey again!"<NL><NL>Father spoke in a cold threatening tone. Immortal Xu pretended to not hear, instead choosing to continue mending his broken shell in silence.

2fb93ab2-d781-47dc-a5f7-05af26af3690/Eve.en: "I'm no more than a few dozen chis away from him. Time to take a swing at his defenses..."
2fb93ab2-d781-47dc-a5f7-05af26af3690/Eve.ru: - Я нахожусь от него не более чем в нескольких дюжинах чи. Время нанести удар по его обороне..."

f6c80bc9-b16e-4c5c-8615-433c14bc67b3/Eve.en: "Haha, looks like I was one move behind. I didn't think this little girl would return so quickly!"<NL>The wooden dummy opened its mouth to speak, sounding almost like two pieces of wood banging together. "Why don't you take a guess who I am?"<NL><NL>You passed glances between your foster father and the speaking dummy, as bewildered as if you were dreaming!

8973c26f-4719-4e9c-9330-c83458e691a4/Eve.en: "Don't make a sound, my child."<NL><NL>Just as you were about to lunge at Immortal Xu, your father suddenly projected his voice into your head:<NL>"Immortal Xu is not an enemy you should underestimate. When I built this dummy, there was a defect in its legs.<NL>When the opportunity arises, strike beneath its waist with the <color=#yellow>Opening and Closing Sword</color>!"<NL><NL>You silently listened to your foster father's instructions and took them to heart.

5396f25e-3f34-4994-91cb-9ff7cadad5b2/Eve.en: "My opponent does not bear arms, while I have a sword in mine. I should exploit his short reach to my advantage,<NL>keep my distance, and strike at his feet when at the opportune moment..."
5396f25e-3f34-4994-91cb-9ff7cadad5b2/Eve.ru: - У моего противника нет оружия, в то время как у меня в руках Меч. Я должен использовать его короткую дистанцию в своих интересах,<NL>держусь на расстоянии и бью его по ногам, когда наступит подходящий момент..."

5396f25e-3f34-4994-91cb-9ff7cadad5b2/Opt.en: (Shift movement slightly while approaching Immortal Xu...)
5396f25e-3f34-4994-91cb-9ff7cadad5b2/Opt.ru: (Слегка измените движение, приближаясь к Бессмертному Сюю...)

ad703a08-231c-41d8-87a2-16e5f0c6673d/Eve.en: "Quit... being silly... wood... feels no pain!<NL>I will not make the same mistake twice! Your sword might be sharp; your little "blacksmith" is also quite resourceful.<NL>Impressive, hehe, impressive indeed!"
ad703a08-231c-41d8-87a2-16e5f0c6673d/Eve.ru: - Перестань... быть глупым... дерево... не чувствует боли!<NL>Я не совершу одну и ту же ошибку дважды! Ваш Меч может быть острым; ваш маленький "кузнец" также весьма изобретателен.<NL>Впечатляет, хе-хе, действительно впечатляет!"

ad703a08-231c-41d8-87a2-16e5f0c6673d/Opt.en: Little blacksmith? Are you trying to make fun of my foster father?
ad703a08-231c-41d8-87a2-16e5f0c6673d/Opt.ru: Маленький кузнец? Ты пытаешься высмеять моего приемного отца?

23a30e44-7c9a-4ee8-8355-2ecd4b877602/Eve.en: "Hahaha! A shapeless ghost, you say?"<NL>Unswayed by the provocative words, the wooden dummy raised its claw and began stroking its chin, as if brushing a patch of nonexistent beard.
23a30e44-7c9a-4ee8-8355-2ecd4b877602/Eve.ru: - Ха-ха-ха! Бесформенный призрак, говоришь?<NL>Не поддавшись на провокационные слова, деревянный манекен поднял клешню и начал поглаживать подбородок, как будто расчесывая клок несуществующей бороды.

23a30e44-7c9a-4ee8-8355-2ecd4b877602/Opt.en: Father, could this be... some demon reincarnated through a "corpse"?
23a30e44-7c9a-4ee8-8355-2ecd4b877602/Opt.ru: Отец, может ли это быть... какой-нибудь демон, перевоплотившийся через "труп"?

7d9dbf1d-cf3c-4383-9485-14eabc58bd8b/Eve.en: Just as you finished your angry words, your foster father began to lose his balance and crumbled to the ground.<NL>Horrified, you rushed to his side and helped him sit up<NL>while the wooden dummy let out a sinister laugh with his hand behind his back.
7d9dbf1d-cf3c-4383-9485-14eabc58bd8b/Eve.ru: Как только вы закончили свои гневные слова, ваш приемный отец начал терять равновесие и рухнул на землю.<NL>В ужасе ты бросилась к нему и помогла сесть<NL>в то время как деревянный манекен издал зловещий смешок, заложив руку за спину.

7d9dbf1d-cf3c-4383-9485-14eabc58bd8b/Opt.en: (I didn't think Father was hurt this bad. That explains why this sick freak was so confident!)
7d9dbf1d-cf3c-4383-9485-14eabc58bd8b/Opt.ru: (Я не думал, что отец пострадал так сильно. Это объясняет, почему этот больной урод был так уверен в себе!)

bb664d81-3e25-4e2d-80d2-06460c4e817e/Eve.en: With a crisp cry, you raised your sword and stabbed forward. Immortal Xu flicked his left hand,<NL>and your blade began to tilt away from its trajectory and missed its intended target.<NL><NL>"Your attempts are futile!" With an almost mechanical cry, Immortal Xu raised his right hand like a claw and lunged toward your meridian on your wrist!

4c1fbaa8-0856-40e0-b9b0-0fb99c9a7e76/Eve.en: "I see it clearly now. One does not simply escape from destiny..."<NL>Father nodded contemplatively before shakily standing upright.<NL>He walked toward Immortal Xu, smoothed out his attire and spoke:<NL>"That is not how you install those joints. Shall I lend you a hand?"<NL><NL>As Father spoke, you and Immortal Xu couldn't help but let out a gasp of astonishment.

4c1fbaa8-0856-40e0-b9b0-0fb99c9a7e76/Opt.en: Cutting Ao's Feet, Vanquish Evil with Might and Magic (Vol.4 over)
4c1fbaa8-0856-40e0-b9b0-0fb99c9a7e76/Opt.ru: Отрезав ноги Ао, Победи зло мечом и магией (Том 4 окончен)

1ed361dc-b755-4e81-ae8d-6db41e397407/Eve.en: Your foster father passed concerned glances at you as you returned.<NL>"My daughter, are you injured? Why is there blood on the wood in Immortal Xu's hand?"<NL><NL>You smiled with glee as you twirled around.
1ed361dc-b755-4e81-ae8d-6db41e397407/Eve.ru: Твой приемный отец бросил на тебя обеспокоенный взгляд, когда ты вернулся.<NL>- Дочь моя, ты ранена? Почему на дереве в руке Бессмертного Сюя кровь?"<NL><NL>Ты радостно улыбалась, кружась вокруг меня.

1ed361dc-b755-4e81-ae8d-6db41e397407/Opt.en: Worry not, Father! That was just a little wound I got from a splinter while chopping wood earlier.
1ed361dc-b755-4e81-ae8d-6db41e397407/Opt.ru: Не волнуйся, отец! Это была всего лишь небольшая Рана, которую я получил от занозы, когда колол дрова ранее.

470052dd-bc32-4cc1-8d63-6ef9a2bf3afb/Eve.en: "Preposterous! Such arrogance!<NL>What can you insignificant mortals expect to do?<NL>I am divinity in the flesh. You can destroy my vessel a thousand times,<NL>but it'll only take my soul three days to reemerge from the ashes to exact my vengeance!"<NL><NL>Immortal Xu spoke in disdain as he rammed the Parasol branches you threw on the ground<NL>at the dummy's wounds and broken limbs.

470052dd-bc32-4cc1-8d63-6ef9a2bf3afb/Opt.en: You speak nothing but shameful boasts! Hey! That Parasol was for my Father! You should at least ask before taking them!
470052dd-bc32-4cc1-8d63-6ef9a2bf3afb/Opt.ru: Ты не говоришь ничего, кроме постыдного хвастовства! Эй! Этот зонтик был для моего отца! Вы должны хотя бы спросить, прежде чем принимать их!

649adb00-182e-4d02-9201-548bd0453bf9/Eve.en: "You lost, freak!"<NL>Not even halfway through unleashing the powerful <color=#yellow>Ao Slaying Blade Art</color>,<NL>Immortal Xu was already suffering from a heavy blow to his chest. His legs shattered as he let out a chilling cry before falling to the ground.<NL>Despite knowing the fact that you are only slicing a wooden dummy, you still couldn't help but feel a sense of sympathy toward it...

649adb00-182e-4d02-9201-548bd0453bf9/Opt.en: You look hurt... are you... No! You deserve the pain! Father will decide what to do with you!
649adb00-182e-4d02-9201-548bd0453bf9/Opt.ru: Ты выглядишь обиженным... ты... Нет! Ты заслуживаешь этой боли! Отец сам решит, что с тобой делать!

41c16334-5f66-4e89-9a4b-42d6efb23488/Eve.en: Just as doubt began to sprout up in your mind,<NL>the wooden dummy suddenly stood up and laughed almost mechanically!
41c16334-5f66-4e89-9a4b-42d6efb23488/Eve.ru: Как раз в тот момент, когда в вашем сознании начали зарождаться сомнения,<NL>деревянный манекен внезапно встал и почти механически рассмеялся!

b7130508-ca3a-4696-badc-208dd2686478/Eve.en: "Yin became empty, as Yang became a deity. Standing in sanctity, onward to immortality."<NL>Father spoke slowly. Each sentence made the wooden dummy laugh with glee and arrogance.<NL><NL>"Except..."<NL>Father paused as he changed his tone, "you may have cultivated a powerful form, but you lack morality and virtue.<NL>You are no immortal. You will be nothing but a shapeless ghost doomed to wander this plane in an inanimate husk!"

43306b7e-fc70-4fe4-91b5-8cdb302ae109/Eve.en: You unleashed three swift strikes, but each was easily deflected by Immortal Xu!<NL>"Curses, if he keeps deflecting my <color=#yellow>Upswings</color> and <color=#yellow>Stabs</color>, I won't be able to fully unleash my <color=#yellow>Opening and Closing Sword</color>.<NL>What should I do?!"
43306b7e-fc70-4fe4-91b5-8cdb302ae109/Eve.ru: Ты нанес три быстрых удара, но каждый был легко отражен Бессмертным Сюем!<NL>- Будь я проклят, если он продолжит отклонять мои <color=#yellow>Подъемы</color> и <color=#yellow>Удары ножом</color>, я не смогу полностью раскрыть свой <color=#yellow>Открывающий и закрывающий Меч</color>.<NL>Что мне следует делать?!"

7cd2d8ff-f26b-4a8d-aa8f-2a5ef52005ad/Eve.en: "I do not believe we've met before.<NL>Who are you? Why do you seek to take my True Qi and do me harm?!"<NL>Father called out to the dummy sitting on the ground.<NL><NL>The dummy, on the other hand, remained completely motionless and still. You couldn't help but begin to worry about your foster father...

7cd2d8ff-f26b-4a8d-aa8f-2a5ef52005ad/Opt.en: Father's been obsessed with that manual, and his True Qi has just been sapped. Could his injuries just then have done a number on his head?
7cd2d8ff-f26b-4a8d-aa8f-2a5ef52005ad/Opt.ru: Отец был одержим этим руководством, и его Истинная ци только что была подорвана. Могли ли его травмы именно тогда сказаться на его голове?

835754f7-22f4-4178-94ff-18bb3712e6a8/Eve.en: "Bend down and swing sideways! Aim for his right elbow!"<NL>Just as the moment became tense, your foster father began to speak in your head.<NL>Without thinking, you quickly retracted your sword and swung it like a saber.<NL>The timing and the aim couldn't have been more perfect. Fearing the strike, Immortal Xu pulled back in distress!<NL><NL>"Now's your chance! Aim for his legs! Strike three times in quick succession!" Your foster father continued!

66c7971e-d4ee-426d-a1e7-8e5c54596034/Eve.en: "Your ignorance is appalling, girl!"<NL>The wooden dummy spoke sharply. He turned to your foster father and continued:<NL><NL>"I have been inside the manual in your possession for a long time, yearning for the day that someone will construct a husk worthy of becoming a vessel for my soul!<NL>Yet, my anticipation has been met with failure after failure. Until you, my little blacksmith, managed to grasp the secrets hidden within!<NL>If I weren't in such a rush to return to my corporeal form, I'd keep you alive for longer.<NL><NL>Tell you what, if you let me have all your True Qi so I can regain my physical form,<NL>I'll spare the lives of your life. What do you say?"

66c7971e-d4ee-426d-a1e7-8e5c54596034/Opt.en: Have you no shame? It is you who should be begging us for your life!
66c7971e-d4ee-426d-a1e7-8e5c54596034/Opt.ru: Неужели у тебя совсем нет стыда? Это ты должен умолять нас сохранить тебе жизнь!

2ce01c26-db45-40b1-8330-6fd86fa17e08/Eve.en: "Do... do not waste your breath with him, my daughter!"
2ce01c26-db45-40b1-8330-6fd86fa17e08/Eve.ru: - Не... не трать на него зря время, дочь моя!

2ce01c26-db45-40b1-8330-6fd86fa17e08/Opt.en: Yes, Father. But this "thing" looks neither human nor object... what should we do with him?
2ce01c26-db45-40b1-8330-6fd86fa17e08/Opt.ru: Да, отец. Но эта "штука" не похожа ни на человека, ни на предмет... что нам с ним делать?

235f32a6-443a-40a9-8704-0d65b8cf09c7/Eve.en: "You might be young and inexperienced, but you've got some talent with that sword.<NL>However... hehe. Even with this unwieldy body, I can still see through your attacks with ease.<NL>Your attempts are nothing but futile!"
235f32a6-443a-40a9-8704-0d65b8cf09c7/Eve.ru: - Может, ты и молод и неопытен, но у тебя есть некоторый Талант обращаться с этим Мечом.<NL>Однако... хе-хе. Даже с таким громоздким телом я все еще с легкостью вижу твои атаки насквозь.<NL>Ваши попытки не что иное, как тщетны!"

235f32a6-443a-40a9-8704-0d65b8cf09c7/Opt.en: You will pay for your arrogance! Eat this!
235f32a6-443a-40a9-8704-0d65b8cf09c7/Opt.ru: Ты заплатишь за свое высокомерие! Съешь это!
